maturation_deltas: Search/report doctrine incorporates Operation C and Coral Sea experience. Weather utilization is a bounded operational improvement in collecting/plotting wind/cloud/front reports; no independent modern weather-forecast technology is created.
Tone scout launch reliability is not forced to repeat the historical late-launch accident; no specific catapult super-technology is asserted.
dependency_notes: AL is detached from MI. FS preparation continues in parallel but is not the first main operation.
MI target attack date moved to 1942-06-10; landing planned 1942-06-13.

first_carrier_striking_force.first_midway_strike: about 114-120 aircraft; substantial anti-ship reserve retained

second_air_echelon.role: independent support/search/convoy CAP/second strike; not merged into first carrier formation

fast_surface_pursuit.heavy_cruisers: Atago/Chokai/Myoko/Haguro class set; exact named split may be finalized at event resolution
fast_surface_pursuit.role: night pursuit after carrier-air mission kills

main_body.distance_policy: roughly 200-250 nmi behind the first carrier force, materially closer than historical
main_body.reason: thicker carrier cover + improved surface combat/speed robustness + reduced operational-risk premium

invasion.landing_strength: about 5800 assault troops plus construction/survey/base personnel
invasion.logistics_priority: AA, artillery ammunition, tractors, engineers, radios, fuel, runway repair rather than extra infantry headcount

submarines.doctrine_change: Forward anti-carrier patrol line is deliberately ordered earlier; delay alone is not treated as sufficient. Multiple sparse layers are used, with K-operation/recon support detached as needed.

base_air.Wake: G3M/G4M about 50-56 ready; A6M about 18-24 ready by eve of attack
base_air.Marshalls_Wotje: flying-boat long-range patrol including small H8K component
base_air.Southeast: 25th Air Flotilla main body remains Rabaul/PM/Solomons to hold MO gains

japanese_plan.Indian_Ocean: Exploit RN weakness with submarines/cruisers/base air; no main carrier commitment.
japanese_plan.FS: Prepare bases/logistics in parallel; not operationally ready to replace MI in May.

US_information_state.assessment_as_of_boundary: Midway roughly 60-65% main-target probability; other Central Pacific 10-15%; South Pacific 15-20%; north about 5%. Attack date/carrier count unknown.
US_information_state.carriers: Enterprise/Hornet scheduled to sortie 1942-06-02 night to 06-03; Saratoga accelerated and expected Pearl about 06-03/04; Wasp cannot reach in time.
US_information_state.midway_air: about 75-90 aircraft at boundary, with continued reinforcement possible.

event_adjudications.Tone_scout: No forced historical 25-30 minute launch delay; launch is treated as on-time within normal small operational variance.
event_adjudications.weather: Historical 1942-06-02/03 fog is not copied because dates differ. Weather remains stochastic. Japanese advantage is bounded to somewhat better collection/plotting and route/search-sector use of broad cloud/front/wind information; local squalls and cloud holes remain unpredictable.
event_adjudications.second_K_operation: French Frigate Shoals refueling method still likely blocked from prior US learning. Alternative submarine floatplane reconnaissance is attempted/considered; success gives only coarse carrier-presence information, not perfect identification/continuous tracking.
